                  <ns0:p n="6">6 Then Ezra rose up before the house of God, and went into the chamber <ns0:note n="m" place="bottom">That he with the Princes and Elders, as it follows, <ns0:hi>v.</ns0:hi> 8. might consult about the Execution of their resolution.</ns0:note> of Johanan the son of Elia<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />shib: and <ns0:hi>when</ns0:hi> he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the trans<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />gression of them that had been carried away.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="7">7 And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem, unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jeru<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />salem;</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="8">8 And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be <ns0:note n="†" place="margin">Heb. <ns0:hi>devoted.</ns0:hi>
                     </ns0:note> forfeited, and him<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />self separated from the congregation <ns0:note n="n" place="bottom">Either by Banishment: Or rather by Excommunication from the Church, and People, and House, and publick Worship of God.</ns0:note> of those that had been carried away.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="9">9 Then all the men of Judah, and Benjamin <ns0:note n="o" place="bottom">Not only of these two Tribes, as appears from the following Catalogue, where there are Priests and Levites; but all the Isra<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />lites, <ns0:hi>v.</ns0:hi> 25. who are thus described, partly because the greatest part of them were of these Tribes, though others were mixed with them: and partly because they all now dwelt in that Land which formerly was appropriated to those Tribes.</ns0:note>, ga<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />thered themselves together unto Jerusalem, within three days: (it <ns0:hi>was</ns0:hi> the ninth month, on the twentieth <ns0:hi>day</ns0:hi> of the month) and all the people sat in the street of the house of God <ns0:note n="p" place="bottom">In that street of the City, which was next to the Temple, and within the view of it, that so they might be as in Gods presence, whereby they might be awed to a more faithful and vigorous prosecution of their work. And this place they might chuse rather than the Court of the Peo<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />ple, because they thought it might be polluted by the delinquents, who were all to come thither.</ns0:note>, trembling because of <ns0:hi>this</ns0:hi> matter, and for <ns0:note n="†" place="margin">Heb. <ns0:hi>the showers.</ns0:hi>
                     </ns0:note> the great rain <ns0:note n="q" place="bottom">Which they took for a token of Gods displeasure amongst them.</ns0:note>.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="10">10 And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and <ns0:note n="†" place="margin">Heb. <ns0:hi>have caused to dwell,</ns0:hi> or <ns0:hi>have brought back.</ns0:hi>
                     </ns0:note> have taken strange wives to encrease the trespass of Israel.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="11">11 Now therefore make confession unto the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure <ns0:note n="r" place="bottom">You have sinfully pleased your selves, now please God by your Obedience to his command.</ns0:note>, and separate your selves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="12">12 Then all the congregation answered, and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="13">13 But the people are many, and <ns0:hi>it is</ns0:hi> a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, nei<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />ther <ns0:hi>is this</ns0:hi> a work of one day or two: for <ns0:note n="‖" place="margin">Or, <ns0:hi>we have greatly offended in this thing.</ns0:hi>
                     </ns0:note> we are many that have transgressed in this thing.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="14">14 Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand <ns0:note n="s" place="bottom">Let the great Council, called the <ns0:hi>Sanhedrim,</ns0:hi> be settled, and meet to judge and determine of all particular causes.</ns0:note>, and let all them which have taken strange wives <ns0:note n="t" place="bottom">To wit, of these heathen Nations such as were not proselyted to the Jewish Religion before their Marriage; or since revolted from it.</ns0:note> in our cities, come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the Judges thereof <ns0:note n="u" place="bottom">Who are best able to inform the great council of the quality of the per<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />sons, and of all matters of Fact and Circumstances.</ns0:note>, until the fierce wrath of our God <ns0:note n="‖" place="margin">Or, <ns0:hi>till this matter be dis<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />patched.</ns0:hi>
                     </ns0:note> for this matter, be turned from us <ns0:note n="x" place="bottom">
                        <ns0:hi>i. e.</ns0:hi> Until the thing be done, and Gods Wrath thereby removed.</ns0:note>.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="15">15 Only Jonathan the son of Asahel, and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah, <ns0:note n="†" place="margin">Heb. <ns0:hi>stood,</ns0:hi> or <ns0:hi>were ap<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />pointed over.</ns0:hi>
                     </ns0:note> were employed about this <ns0:hi>mat<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />ter</ns0:hi> 
                     <ns0:note n="y" place="bottom">To wit, to take due care that the business should be executed in the manner proposed, that the Officers and Delinquents of eve<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />ry City should come successively in convenient time and order, as these should appoint, and to take and keep an exact account of the whole transaction, and of the names of the Cities and Per<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />sons whose causes were dispatched, and to give notice to others <ns0:gap reason="illegible" resp="#APEX" extent="1+ letters">
                           <ns0:desc>•…</ns0:desc>
                        </ns0:gap>o come in their turns, and to prepare the business for the hearing of the Judges. And these two were Priests, as their Coadjutors or helpers were Levites; that so they might inform the persons con<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />cerned, if any matter of doubt did arise.</ns0:note>: and Meshullam, and Shabbethai the Levite help<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />ed them.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="16">
                     <ns0:pb facs="tcp:107763:368" />16 And the children of the captivity did so: and Ezra the priest, <ns0:hi>with</ns0:hi> certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by <ns0:hi>their</ns0:hi> names were separated <ns0:note n="z" place="bottom">
                        <ns0:hi>i. e.</ns0:hi> Sequestred themselves from all other business, and gave themselves wholly to this.</ns0:note>, and sate down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="17">17 And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives, by the first day of the first month.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="18">18 And among the sons of the priests, there were found that had taken strange wives: <ns0:hi>namely,</ns0:hi> of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maasejah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedahah.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="19">19 And they gave their hand <ns0:note n="a" place="bottom">
                        <ns0:hi>i. e.</ns0:hi> They covenanted or swore by giving their hand; which was the usual gesture in those cases. Of which see <ns0:hi>Levit.</ns0:hi> 6. 2. <ns0:hi>Ezek.</ns0:hi> 17. 18.</ns0:note>, that they would put away their wives: and <ns0:hi>being</ns0:hi> guilty, <ns0:hi>they offered</ns0:hi> a ram of the flock for their trespass.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="20">20 And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zeba<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />diah.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="21">21 And of the sons of Harim; Maasejah, and Elijah, and Shemajah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="22">22 And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maasejah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="23">23 Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelajah, (the same <ns0:hi>is</ns0:hi> Kelita) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="24">24 Of the singers also, Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="25">25 Moreover of Israel <ns0:note n="b" place="bottom">
                        <ns0:hi>i. e.</ns0:hi> Of the people of Israel, distinguished from the Priests and the Levites hitherto named, who before were called <ns0:hi>Iudah</ns0:hi> and <ns0:hi>Benjamin, v.</ns0:hi> 9. where see the notes.</ns0:note>: of the sons of Parosh, Ra<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />miah, and Jeziah, and Malchia, and Miamin, and E<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />leazar, and Malchijah, and Benajah.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="26">26 And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zecha<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />riah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and E<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />liah.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="27">27 And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="28">28 Of the sons also of Bebai, Jehohanan, Hanani<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />ah, Zabbai, <ns0:hi>and</ns0:hi> Athlai.</ns0:p>

                  <ns0:p n="30">30 And of the sons of Pahath-moab; Adna, and Chelal, Benajah, Maasejah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="31">31 And <ns0:hi>of</ns0:hi> the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemajah, Shimeon,</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="32">32 Benjamin, Malluch, <ns0:hi>and</ns0:hi> Shemariah.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="33">33 Of the sons of Hashum; Matanai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, <ns0:hi>and</ns0:hi> Shimei.</ns0:p>

                  <ns0:p n="43">43 Of the sons of Nebo; Jehiel, Mattithiah, Za<ns0:g ref="char:EOLhyphen" />bad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benajah.</ns0:p>
                  <ns0:p n="44">44 All these had taken strange wives: and <ns0:hi>some</ns0:hi> of them had wives by whom they had children <ns0:note n="c" place="bottom">Whereby he implies that most of their Wives were barren.
